The '''Prototype Czerka NaviGo chipset''' was a chipset manufactured by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. [[Darth Immern]] upgraded [[MZ-12]], his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] navigator with a Prototype Czerka NaviGo chipset.
